# Discovery Log — target 50,000 reliable companies (resolvable careers/job-board URL)

STATUS (2026-07-24): GOAL REACHED then CLEANED. After live board-API validation
  + cleanup: reliable_count=43230 in discovery.db (52.7k pre-cleanup; ~4700 dead
  boards dropped, 1000 himalayas aggregators, 14 junk slugs, ~5800 duplicate rows);
  companies.json=50835 (28270 automatable). Baked into the running app (container
  `job-auto`, http://localhost:8000, restarted with cleaned dataset + config).
  NOTE: post-cleanup reliable (43.2k) is BELOW 50k — the original 50k included
  ~4.7k unverified-dead boards. To return to 50k verified, import more ATS slugs
  (see bulk sources below) and re-run validate_boards.py + cleanup + re-bake.
  Data-quality scripts: scripts/validate_boards.py (liveness via engine
  enumerators), scripts/cleanup_discovery_db.py (aggregators/junk/dups),
  scripts/export_discovery_db.py (db->raw bridge). config.yaml exclude_keywords
  now also blocks hardware/robotics/physical/material/mechanical/electrical/
  electronics/semiconductor test roles (keep only software-stack test/automation).

HIGHEST-YIELD BULK SOURCES (deterministic, no WebSearch budget needed — re-run
anytime, idempotent via norm_key dedup):
  - python scripts/discover_gh_aggregator.py     # Feashliaa/job-board-aggregator slug arrays: greenhouse/lever/ashby/bamboohr/workday
  - python scripts/discover_ats_scrapers.py       # kalil0321/ats-scrapers CSVs: +smartrecruiters/workable/personio/teamtailor/rippling/pinpoint/breezy (+greenhouse/lever/ashby/bamboohr/workday extras)
  - LLM cohort B (32 web-search agents) — bounded by the 200/session WebSearch cap; pivots to `gh search code` + raw-file mining when WebSearch is exhausted.

RESUME / RE-BAKE IN A NEW SESSION:
  1. cd /mnt/380/Projects/job_auto/repo
  2. python scripts/run_discovery.py status        # reliable_count vs 50000
  3. (optional growth) python scripts/discover_gh_aggregator.py && python scripts/discover_ats_scrapers.py   # idempotent; picks up newly-added slugs
  4. (optional growth) relaunch LLM agents over remaining partitions via the Agent tool
  5. PROCESS INTO THE APP (discovery.db -> companies.json -> dashboard):
       python scripts/export_discovery_db.py       # discovery.db reliable -> data/raw/agent_discoverydb.json
       python scripts/consolidate.py               # raw/*.json -> data/companies.json (single writer)
       docker cp data/companies.json job-auto:/app/data/companies.json   # update the running volume (preserves jobs.db)
       docker cp data/companies.csv  job-auto:/app/data/companies.csv
       docker cp data/ats_summary.json job-auto:/app/data/ats_summary.json
       docker cp data/by_ats job-auto:/app/data/by_ats_new && docker exec job-auto sh -c "rm -rf /app/data/by_ats && mv /app/data/by_ats_new /app/data/by_ats"
     (or, for a clean rebuild that bakes the new dataset into the image: ./run.sh up --build,
      but note the jobauto-data volume shadows the image's data/ — copy files in as above to keep the existing jobs.db)

FORMAT: each line = <iso8601> | <worker> | NEW | <company> | <ats|custom> | <url> | <http-status>
A company counts toward 50k only if it has a resolvable careers URL
(ATS-host board URL, trusted — or a /careers page returning HTTP 200, validated).
Name-only companies are kept but do NOT count toward the 50k goal.
